ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense stochastic white mottling across the left lobe surface; right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with sparse white punctate spots; distinct tan/brown textured masses at the lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree angle at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, with notable pixel-depth variations at the margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a high-amplitude convex sweep; the right lobe follows a more linear, diagonal trajectory towards the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups concentrated across the visible surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Protruding, brownish-orange textured masses (likely sessile barnacle colonies) attached to the distal tips and upper margins of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the heavily mottled left lobe and the predominantly dark right lobe.
